trap.label: plural
trap.wrong: The countries found areas of common interests.
trap.right: The countries found areas of common interest.
trap.why: Em português “interesses comuns” é plural. Em inglês, a expressão fixa é areas of common interest (singular).

fix.wrong: The envoy took note about the proposal.
fix.right: The envoy took note of the proposal.

fix.wrong: The cable were sent by the envoy.
fix.right: The cable was sent by the envoy.

fix.wrong: They had a frank exchange of views, but agree on nothing.
fix.right: They had a frank exchange of views but agreed on nothing.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com views with concern: “The government is worried about the plan.”
rewrite.answer: The government views the plan with concern.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com takes note of: “The ministry knows about the proposal but does not agree.”
rewrite.answer: The ministry takes note of the proposal.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “They take note of it.”
